qualification: Installed Director, ordinary Git staging, and prepared linked checkout in disposable local repositories.
outcomes: Fresh coordinator exposes the portable registry and an unrelated sibling while excluding exactly the machine-local source paths and bindings.
A tracked entry and a staged removal in HEAD both block setup. Custom lower-precedence rollback preserves owner bytes and mode.
Direct registration with a negated exclusion or missing dedicated descriptor leaves registry and bindings absent. Restored setup can register.
Guided linked apply verifies the selected worktree and preserves a retained bindings transaction before replay when the selected worktree negates an exclusion.
Native APFS accepted same-file case aliases. Literal lower-case Git pathspec did not expose the indexed uppercase name, so case-aware configured comparisons inspect the full tracked summaries.
